subject: Collaborative exec panel + podcast + blog swap — Thought Leaders Summit
messages:
From: Jordan Myers <jordan@lumenix.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Idea — joint exec panel + podcast + blog swap at Thought Leaders Summit

Hi Ben / Marissa / Karthik,

Hope you’re well — quick intro, I’m Jordan (events lead at Lumenix). We’re building the program for our Thought Leaders Summit (SF, Sep 22-23) and I wanted to float an idea for a joint track with Redwood:

- 45-minute executive panel (Redwood + 2 customers) focusing on "serving LLMs at scale: economics & reliability"
- 30-minute fireside chat (product / roadmap lens)
- Post-event: 30-40 minute live-recorded podcast episode with the same speakers
- Accompanying blog swap (we publish a short recap and you publish a thought piece)

We can co-brand, provide event promo credits, and include a small stipend for speaker travel if needed. Attached is a one-pager with audience demographics and estimated reach.

If this sounds interesting I’d love to set a 30-minute sync next week to align on format and promotional commitments.

Attachments: Lumenix_OnePager.pdf (audience & sponsorship options)

Cheers,
Jordan
Jordan Myers
Head of Events, Lumenix

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Idea — joint exec panel + podcast + blog swap at Thought Leaders Summit

Jordan — thanks, this looks promising. We’d be interested in partnering. A few quick asks / notes from our side:

- Format: we prefer the 45min panel + 30min fireside + recorded podcast approach you sketched. Can we ensure the podcast is recorded on-site (or via clean remote feed) the day after the panel?
- Redwood speaker: I can confirm our VP Product (Anjali Rao) as the primary speaker, with a backfill option from VP Eng if schedule shifts. I’ll attach a short bio and headshot once you confirm.
- Promo commitments: we can commit to 3 social posts, 1 customer email to a targeted list, and a co-authored blog post. We’ll need your expected deliverable list and timing.
- Budget: travel stipend yes — please send a ballpark range. Also send the sponsor contract when you have it (DocuSign or similar).

I attached our sponsor tiers and a rough draft agenda (xlsx) to speed discussion. Proposed times for a sync: Tue 5/25 10am PT or Wed 5/26 11am PT. What works?

Attachments: Redwood_Sponsor_Tiers.pdf, draft_agenda.xlsx

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference

Ben — thanks for the quick reply and the materials. Wed 5/26 11am PT works for us — calendar invite sent. Quick clarifications before the call: 

- Podcast: yes, we can record on-site and provide a clean track. We also offer a post-prod edited episode and distribution through our channels.
- Travel stipend: we typically cover up to $1500 per speaker for domestic travel; for international we can extend to $3k plus hotel. Let us know needs.
- Deliverables: we’ll provide 4 social posts (2 organic, 2 paid), a dedicated event email, and a speaker prep doc. We expect partners to share 2 social posts + a blog post within 2 weeks post-event.
- Contract: here’s the DocuSign link for a basic co-marketing + speaker agreement: https://app.docusign.com/s/EXAMPLE-Lumenix-Redwood (please review).

On the agenda sheet I suggested a 45min panel (moderated), 30min fireside, then a 20-minute audience Q&A. For the podcast we’ll reserve a 40min slot the afternoon after the panel for recording and quick edits.

See you Wed — Jordan

Attachments: (none in this message)
